title: Labor wins Greens support for trust changes in exchange for scrapping jet fuel subsidies for the wealthy
summary: Government also agrees to carve out pensioners from cuts to private health insurance rebates in return for minor party’s support in Senate
byline: Sarah Basford Canales and Krishani Dhanji

blocks.text:
Government also agrees to carve out pensioners from cuts to private health insurance rebates in return for minor party’s support in Senate

  • Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates

  • Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast

Private jet owners will no longer receive fuel tax subsidies after the Albanese government secured the Greens’ agreement to undo the sweetheart deal in exchange for supporting a controversial minimum tax rate on discretionary trusts.

The government is eager to pass four key pieces of legislation before parliament finishes for the year, including laws to create a gas reservation scheme.
